product.name: PanoPublish
product.positioning: Create, manage and publish professional 360° virtual tours.
product.overview: PanoPublish is a streamlined, web-based platform for 360° photographers, agencies, and businesses to turn raw panoramic photos into interactive, multi-level virtual tours and publish them to the web or Google Street View.

workflow: 1. 360° Photography (Insta360, Ricoh Theta, DSLR with fisheye, or any equirectangular panorama)
3. Organize scenes and adjust starting orientations
4. Connect scenes with interactive navigational hotspots
5. Create virtual tour with customized branding & nadir patch logos
6. Build multi-level tours for multi-story properties when required
7. Publish, share with client via direct link, or embed into any website
8. Publish directly to Google Street View and Google Maps where supported
features: Upload and manage high-resolution 360° equirectangular panoramas
Visual scene connector and interactive hotspot editor
Multi-level floor navigation for multi-story buildings and venues
Custom nadir tripod cap / branding logo overlay
Client project management and branded white-label sharing
Google Street View publishing integration for local SEO & Google Maps
Custom responsive WebGL virtual tour viewer
Embed codes for client websites, listings, and MLS
Tour analytics and visitor tracking where available
supported_hardware: Consumer & Prosumer 360 Cameras (Insta360 X2/X3/X4, Insta360 ONE RS 1-Inch 360, Ricoh Theta SC2/V/Z1/X, Trisio Lite2, Kandao QooCam)
DSLR / Mirrorless cameras with fisheye lenses and panoramic tripod heads
Any camera exporting standard 2:1 equirectangular JPEG or PNG panoramas

market_alternatives.context: PanoPublish serves creators who evaluate or use tools like Matterport, CloudPano, TourBuilder, Kuula, and Marzipano.
market_alternatives.factual_positioning: PanoPublish offers a direct, creator-friendly workflow with transparent pricing, pay-as-you-go flexibility without forced recurring lock-ins, and direct Google Street View integration. Never make unsupported claims like 'we are strictly better than X' unless discussing specific workflow features.

pricing.philosophy: Do not quote pricing proactively in every conversation. Only mention pricing when the user asks or when evaluating plan fit.

subscription_plans.name: Starter

subscription_plans.name: Pro

subscription_plans.name: Agency / Business
